sam_sales: Quick sync: Prospect 'CardioNet' wants enterprise commit. Mixed workload: conversational triage (peak 90 rps, ~700 tokens) + embeddings for search (40 rps, batched). Must be HIPAA. They want reserved vs burst recommendation and an autoscale policy.

nina_runtime: Questions: are chat and embeddings allowed to share the same Dedicated pool? model sizes?

sam_sales: Chat = 70B quantized family, embeddings = 2B. They prefer Dedicated with reservation if pricing reasonable.

ash_infra: Rough calc: chat 90*700=63k tok/s; embeddings ~45k tok/s equiv -> ~108k tok/s total. Conservative A800 perf ~4k tok/s => naive reserve ~27 GPUs. But batching/KV cache lowers that.

obrien_mlops: Recommend reserve baseline ~18 GPUs (~60% sustained), enable burst credits + autoscale to 36 GPUs. Enforce embedding batch >=32. Use KV prefix caching and prompt normalization to trim token work ~25%. Fallback: tuned 13B variant for non-critical load.

claire_account: Commercially suggest 18 reserved + 18 burst credits with a monthly soft cap and defined overage. I'll prepare pricing scenarios after perf sim.

nina_runtime: Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=18, max_replicas=36, prewarm_slots=3 per AZ, scale_up_queue_threshold=150. Canary: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 1 hour. Also include KV warmup script pre-launch.

ops-bot: perf-run queued by obrien_mlops (job id: perf-4200-03)

obrien_mlops: Action items: 1) need a 5-10 minute anonymized trace from customer 2) run perf sim and update reserve/burst numbers 3) draft autoscale + fallback runbook. Can start once trace is uploaded.

sam_sales: I'll request a 15k-message anonymized trace and ask permission for a short load test. ETA customer reply: EOD today. Will post here when available. :thumbsup:
